This paper demonstrates how copyright infringement by artificial intelligence reduces the economic reliability of intellectual property for purposes of collateralization, securitization, and sale-and-lease-back structures. Likewise, it clarifies what differences obtain between AI-driven companies and right holders, and what financial implication the infringement has on both of them. Furthermore, the paper demonstrates how the IP-backed financial structures work with copyright. Finally, it looks into the effects of the infringement on copyright and what pre-transaction due diligence will be like for investors and financiers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI版权侵权如何影响知识产权作为金融抵押品的可靠性，特别是AI训练过程中固有的侵权风险如何改变交易前尽职调查，降低IP资产在证券化、抵押和售后回租等金融交易中的经济价值。
AI.research_question: 人工智能版权侵权如何影响知识产权作为金融抵押品、证券化和售后回租结构的可靠性和经济价值？
AI.motivation: 随着无形资产融资快速增长，知识产权越来越多地被用作金融交易的抵押品和证券化标的。然而，AI系统带来的版权不确定性（特别是训练过程中的侵权风险）在交易前尽职调查中未得到足够重视，这种不确定性直接影响资产估值、可融资性和信用风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 版权法与金融交易交叉理论；2. 无形资产估值与风险定价理论；3. AI侵权责任理论（从部署风险转向训练过程风险）；4. 交易前尽职调查理论在知识产权领域的应用
AI.method: 理论分析与法律经济学方法，通过比较传统版权侵权风险与AI侵权风险的特征差异，分析其对金融交易结构的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1. AI侵权风险从"使用阶段"转移到"训练阶段"，成为模型固有的内在风险；2. 这种不确定性直接降低IP资产作为金融抵押品的可靠性和估值；3. AI驱动的公司与传统权利持有者在金融影响上存在显著差异；4. 版权问题从执法边缘转移到交易风险评估的核心位置
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI时代版权风险向金融领域迁移的理论框架；2. 建立AI侵权风险与IP资产金融化之间的理论联系；3. 拓展了交易前尽职调查理论在AI版权领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和金融机构提供AI时代IP资产尽职调查的新框架；2. 帮助AI公司和权利持有者理解金融影响差异；3. 为政策制定者提供金融稳定视角下的AI版权监管建议；4. 指导IP支持型金融结构的设计和风险评估

title: The Iron Rice Bowl Revival: Why Public Sector Jobs Outpay Private Enterprises for Fresh Graduates in China
affiliations: Hanshan Normal University and Hanshan Normal University

detail.title: The Iron Rice Bowl Revival: Why Public Sector Jobs Outpay Private Enterprises for Fresh Graduates in China
detail.abstract: Challenging the conventional wisdom that private sector jobs pay more, this study documents an "Iron Rice Bowl Revival"—a phenomenon where public sector starting salaries significantly exceed private sector wages for fresh graduates from non-elite universities in China. Analyzing administrative data from 2,053 mathematics graduates (2020–2025) at a Guangdong normal university, we find public sector employees earn 914 CNY (18.1%) more monthly than private sector counterparts (t=8.81, p<.001). This premium intensified dramatically after 2023, from 5.5% to 27.9%, coinciding with China's "civil service examination fever." Propensity score analysis yields a robust average treatment effect of +565 CNY. Including non-wage benefits, the total compensation gap reaches 25–35%. These findings reframe "civil service fever" as rational economic behavior, with implications for labor market theory and graduate career counseling in transitional economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现中国非精英大学毕业生中出现了"铁饭碗复兴"现象，公共部门起薪显著高于私营部门，特别是在2023年后差距急剧扩大，这重新定义了"公务员热"为理性经济行为。
AI.research_question: 中国非精英大学毕业生中，公共部门和私营部门的起薪差距如何？这种差距随时间如何变化？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统认为私营部门工资更高的观点，解释中国出现的"公务员热"现象背后的经济理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分割理论、公共部门溢价理论、理性选择理论、过渡经济中的职业选择理论。
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年广东某师范大学2053名数学毕业生的行政数据，进行描述性统计、t检验、倾向得分分析（PSM）来估计平均处理效应。
AI.findings: 1. 公共部门员工月薪比私营部门高914元（18.1%）；2. 2023年后差距从5.5%急剧扩大到27.9%；3. 倾向得分分析显示平均处理效应为+565元；4. 包含非工资福利后总薪酬差距达25-35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了私营部门工资更高的传统观点；2. 将"公务员热"重新定义为理性经济行为而非非理性追捧；3. 为过渡经济中的劳动力市场理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为毕业生职业咨询提供实证依据；2. 为政策制定者理解劳动力市场动态提供参考；3. 帮助理解中国"公务员考试热"的经济基础。

title: Psychological Safety in Clinical Learning and Its Relationship with Learning Engagement and Clinical Self-Efficacy among Undergraduate Nursing Students in the Philippines
affiliations: and Pangasinan State University

detail.title: Psychological Safety in Clinical Learning and Its Relationship with Learning Engagement and Clinical Self-Efficacy among Undergraduate Nursing Students in the Philippines

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no funding no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained from the Ethics Review Committee of Don Mariano Marcos Memorial State University (Approval Code: NURSING-2024-3076A, Series of 2024). The study was conducted in accordance with the ethical principles of the Declaration of Helsinki. Participation was voluntary, and electronic informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to survey access. Data were stored securely and were accessible only to the research team.
declarations.funderStatement: no funding
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: not a trial paper, not a case report

contentType.other: manuscript, not underwent peer review, for initial submission

detail.abstract: Objective: To examine the relationship between psychological safety in clinical learning environments and learning engagement and clinical self-efficacy among undergraduate nursing students. Methodology: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 500 Level 3 and Level 4 nursing students enrolled in private nursing schools in Region I, Philippines. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire assessing psychological safety in clinical placements, learning engagement, and clinical selfefficacy. Internal consistency was evaluated using Cronbach's alpha. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and scale distributions. Spearman correlation and multiple linear regression analyses were performed to examine associations among the variables. Results: Participants reported moderate levels of psychological safety (3.02 ± 1.28), learning engagement (2.99 ± 1.25), and clinical self-efficacy (3.00 ± 1.27). All scales demonstrated excellent internal consistency (α = 0.968-0.975). Psychological safety was positively associated with learning engagement (r = 0.527, p < 0.001) and clinical self-efficacy (r = 0.628, p < 0.001). Regression analysis indicated that psychological safety significantly predicted learning engagement (B = 0.518, p < 0.001). Both psychological safety (B = 0.388, p < 0.001) and learning engagement (B = 0.456, p < 0.001) independently predicted clinical selfefficacy. Conclusion: Perceived psychological safety in clinical settings is strongly related to student engagement and confidence in clinical performance. Educational strategies that cultivate respectful supervision and open communication may strengthen professional preparation and support readiness for practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了护理学生临床学习环境中的心理安全感与学习投入度和临床自我效能感之间的关系，发现心理安全感能显著预测学习投入度，而心理安全感和学习投入度都能独立预测临床自我效能感。
AI.research_question: 护理学生临床学习环境中的心理安全感如何影响学习投入度和临床自我效能感？
AI.motivation: 临床学习环境对护理学生的专业发展至关重要，但心理安全感在这一过程中的作用尚未充分研究。了解心理安全感如何影响学生的学习投入和临床自信，有助于改善护理教育质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理安全感理论、学习投入理论和自我效能感理论，探讨临床环境中这些构念之间的相互关系。
AI.method: 采用描述性横断面研究设计，对菲律宾第一地区私立护理学校的500名三年级和四年级护理学生进行调查。使用结构化问卷评估心理安全感、学习投入度和临床自我效能感，通过Cronbach's alpha评估内部一致性，使用Spearman相关和多元线性回归分析变量间关系。
AI.findings: 参与者报告了中等水平的心理安全感（3.02±1.28）、学习投入度（2.99±1.25）和临床自我效能感（3.00±1.27）。心理安全感与学习投入度（r=0.527）和临床自我效能感（r=0.628）呈正相关。回归分析显示心理安全感显著预测学习投入度（B=0.518），而心理安全感（B=0.388）和学习投入度（B=0.456）都能独立预测临床自我效能感。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了心理安全感在临床学习环境中的重要性，扩展了心理安全感理论在护理教育领域的应用，明确了心理安全感、学习投入度和临床自我效能感之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为护理教育者提供了实证依据，表明通过培养尊重的监督和开放的沟通来增强心理安全感，可以提高学生的学习投入度和临床自信，从而改善专业准备和实践准备。

title: Welfare-maximizing Budget-balanced Mechanisms for Public Goods
affiliations: and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT) - School of Science

detail.title: Welfare-maximizing Budget-balanced Mechanisms for Public Goods
detail.abstract: We study deterministic direct mechanisms for the provision of an indivisible public good with private values and known type distributions. Imposing dominant-strategy incentive compatibility, ex post individual rationality, and exact ex post budget balance, welfare maximization reduces to choosing provision thresholds (cost shares) that sum to the cost (the "Third Best" class characterized by Kuzmics and Steg). Exact ex post balance adds an individual-feasibility bottleneck: provision requires that every agent can cover her assigned share. Using a reliability-theory representation in terms of survival, hazard, and mean residual life functions, we characterize when equal cost shares (symmetric thresholds) are optimal in the i.i.d. symmetric environment. For two agents (N = 2), symmetry is optimal if and only if the ratio of mean residual life to hazard is decreasing; symmetry is optimal for all N ≥ 2 if and only if the survival function is log-concave (equivalently, the hazard rate is increasing). We then compare Third-Best welfare to the VCG/pivot benchmark. When costs scale proportionally with population size, we derive the exponential rate of the welfare gap via large-deviation methods, separating an individual "everyone can pay" tail event from the aggregate feasibility event. In heterogeneous environments with independent types and log-concave survivals, we establish a convex formulation and provide KKT characterizations. Finally, numerical illustrations quantify how limited deficit tolerance (a relaxation of exact budget balance) can recover substantial welfare.

AI.tldr: 研究确定性直接机制下不可分割公共品的供给问题，在满足占优策略激励相容、事后个人理性和精确事后预算平衡约束下，通过可靠性理论方法分析成本分摊对称性的最优条件，并与VCG基准比较福利差距。
AI.research_question: 在满足占优策略激励相容、事后个人理性和精确事后预算平衡约束下，如何设计最优的公共品供给机制？特别是，在什么条件下对称的成本分摊（平等分摊）是最优的？
AI.motivation: 公共品供给机制设计面临激励相容、个人理性和预算平衡的多重约束，精确的事后预算平衡要求每个参与者都能支付其分摊成本，这形成了"个人可行性瓶颈"。需要分析在何种条件下对称机制是最优的，以及预算平衡约束对福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论，采用Kuzmics和Steg提出的"第三优"机制框架，结合可靠性理论中的生存函数、风险率和平均剩余寿命等概念，分析对称成本分摊的最优条件。
AI.method: 使用可靠性理论方法，通过生存函数、风险率和平均剩余寿命函数分析对称阈值的最优性；采用大偏差方法分析福利差距的指数速率；在异质环境中建立凸规划问题并提供KKT特征。
AI.findings: 1) 在i.i.d.对称环境中，两个参与者时对称最优当且仅当平均剩余寿命与风险率之比递减；所有N≥2时对称最优当且仅当生存函数对数凹（等价于风险率递增）。2) 与VCG基准比较，当成本随人口规模成比例变化时，福利差距呈指数衰减。3) 在异质独立类型和对数凹生存函数环境中，可建立凸规划问题。4) 数值模拟显示有限赤字容忍度可显著恢复福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了可靠性理论在机制设计中的应用框架；2) 给出了对称成本分摊最优性的精确条件；3) 分析了精确预算平衡约束下的福利损失特征；4) 提供了异质环境下的凸规划分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为公共品供给机制设计提供了具体的对称性条件判断标准；2) 揭示了预算平衡约束的实际福利影响；3) 表明有限赤字容忍度可作为改善福利的实用策略；4) 为政策制定者提供了机制设计的量化参考。

title: Domestic Market Segmentation and Spatial Income Inequality
affiliations: Miami University and University of Houston

detail.title: Domestic Market Segmentation and Spatial Income Inequality
detail.abstract: In this paper, we study spatial income inequality within China. Using unique interregional trade data, we document a significant negative provincial border effect: in the industrial sector, trade between two cities in different provinces is about 92% lower than trade between cities within the same province, suggesting the presence of strong domestic market segmentation. To quantify these effects, we develop and calibrate a multi-region, multi-sector quantitative general equilibrium model that features provincial trade frictions. Counterfactuals show that removing provincial trade frictions reduces variance of log real wages by about 8% and lowers the 90/10 income ratio by about 17%.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国省际贸易数据发现显著的省级边界效应：跨省城市间工业贸易比省内城市间低约92%，表明存在严重的国内市场分割。通过构建多区域多部门一般均衡模型，量化分析显示消除省级贸易摩擦可使实际工资对数方差降低8%，90/10收入比下降17%。
AI.research_question: 中国省级边界如何影响区域间贸易流动和收入不平等？消除省级贸易摩擦对减少收入不平等有何影响？
AI.motivation: 中国存在显著的国内市场分割现象，省级边界可能成为贸易壁垒，影响资源配置效率并加剧区域收入不平等，需要量化这些影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新经济地理学和贸易理论，构建多区域多部门一般均衡模型，包含省级贸易摩擦和区域间贸易成本。
AI.method: 使用独特的省际贸易数据实证分析省级边界效应，开发并校准包含省级贸易摩擦的多区域多部门定量一般均衡模型，进行反事实模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 工业部门跨省城市贸易比省内城市贸易低约92%，存在显著省级边界效应；2. 消除省级贸易摩擦可使实际工资对数方差降低8%，90/10收入比下降17%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将边界效应分析从国际扩展到国内省级层面；2. 开发包含省级贸易摩擦的定量一般均衡框架；3. 为国内市场分割的经济后果提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供量化省级贸易壁垒影响的工具；2. 表明消除省级贸易摩擦可显著降低收入不平等；3. 为区域一体化政策提供实证依据。

title: The Cantor's Paradise
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: The Cantor's Paradise
detail.abstract: Georg Cantor (1845-1918) transformed infinity from a philosophical notion into a precise mathematical structure. His key insight-that two sets have the same size exactly when their elements can be placed in bijection-led to a rigorous theory of cardinality revealing an unexpected hierarchy of infinite magnitudes. This survey develops the full Cantorian programme with detailed proofs and modern context. We establish that |Z| = |Q| = ℵ 0 , build a countability toolkit (closure under countable unions, countability of algebraic numbers, existence of transcendentals), and present Cantor's diagonal argument to show |R| > ℵ 0. The Cantor-Bernstein-Schröder theorem yields |P(N)| = |R| and |R n | = |R|, while Cantor's power-set theorem |A| < |P(A)| generates an unbounded tower of cardinals motivating the aleph and beth hierarchies. We explain how naive set theory collapses under Russell's paradox and how Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory with Choice (ZFC) resolves it, developing the cumulative hierarchy V α , ordinal arithmetic, transfinite induction, and Cantor normal form. König's theorem and its corollaries constrain cardinal exponentiation. On the analytic side, we construct the Cantor set, establish its measure-zero yet uncountable character, and discuss Cantor space, the Cantor function, and Hausdorff dimension. The independence of the Continuum Hypothesis is treated via Gödel's constructible universe L and Cohen's forcing. We conclude by tracing Cantor's diagonal method through Gödel's incompleteness theorems, Turing's Halting Problem, and the modern large-cardinal hierarchy. We also address the recently strengthened evidence-including a long-lost 1873 letter discovered in 2025-that Cantor published key results from Richard Dedekind's correspondence without adequate attribution, and discuss its implications for the historiography of set theory.

AI.tldr: 本文全面梳理了康托尔的集合论发展历程，从基本概念到现代扩展，包括基数理论、对角线论证、连续统假设、集合论公理化，以及康托尔与戴德金之间的学术争议。
AI.research_question: 康托尔如何将无限从哲学概念转化为精确的数学结构，以及这一理论如何发展成现代集合论体系？
AI.motivation: 康托尔的集合论革命性地改变了数学对无限的理解，但其完整理论体系需要系统梳理，包括历史争议和现代发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 康托尔基数理论、对角线论证、幂集定理、序数理论、ZFC公理化集合论、连续统假设独立性证明。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，包括详细证明、历史文献考察（如1873年新发现信件）和现代数学框架整合。
AI.findings: 建立了完整的康托尔无限理论体系，揭示了无限基数的层次结构，证明了连续统假设的独立性，并发现了康托尔可能未充分引用戴德金贡献的历史证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化康托尔集合论，连接古典理论与现代发展，澄清历史争议，为无限数学研究提供完整理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数学基础、逻辑学、计算机科学（停机问题）提供理论基础，促进对无限概念的深入理解，影响数学哲学和科学史研究。

title: The Original Defensive War Power

detail.title: The Original Defensive War Power
detail.abstract:
In justifying recent military actions lacking congressional authorization, presidents have invoked a "defensive" war power to justify everything from attacks on drug boats to air battles over Israel to the bombing of Iran's nuclear facilities. The Department of Justice Office of Legal Counsel (OLC) has enabled these operations through an expansive interpretation of the President's power to wage a defensive war. OLC grounds this expansive presidential authority in President Washington's 1790 offensive against the Wabash Indians and Jefferson's 1801 naval operations against Barbary pirates. This Article shows that OLC has fundamentally misread both episodes, and that a third largely ignored conflict provides further confirmation of a restrictive unilateral presidential war power.
Examining contemporaneous debates in all three conflicts—the Northwestern Confederacy War, the First Barbary War, and Andrew Jackson's 1818 seizure of East Florida—this article recovers a narrower original understanding of the defensive war power. The original doctrine only authorized the President to (1) repel an actual invasion; or (2) fight a war already declared against the United States by a foreign power. OLC’s interpretation is not a faithful application of Founding-era precedents, but an adaptation to social, technological, and geopolitical changes that have lowered the political and practical costs of unilateral action. This Article closes by considering the implications of the original defensive war power for interbranch cooperation on judicial review in national security matters.

AI.tldr: 本文分析总统单方面发动"防御性"战争的权力，指出司法部法律顾问办公室(OLC)错误解读历史先例，实际上建国时期的防御性战争权力仅限于(1)击退实际入侵或(2)应对已向美国宣战的外国势力。
AI.research_question: 总统单方面发动"防御性"战争的宪法权力范围是什么？司法部法律顾问办公室对历史先例的解读是否准确？
AI.motivation: 近年来总统未经国会授权频繁以"防御性"战争权力为由采取军事行动，从打击毒品船只到轰炸伊朗核设施，司法部法律顾问办公室通过扩大解释总统权力支持这些行动，但历史依据存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法分权理论、战争权力条款、原始主义解释方法、建国时期对行政权力的理解。
AI.method: 历史文献分析，考察三个关键冲突的同期辩论：西北邦联战争(1790)、第一次巴巴里战争(1801)、安德鲁·杰克逊1818年占领东佛罗里达。
AI.findings: OLC错误解读了华盛顿和杰斐逊的先例，原始防御性战争权力仅授权总统：(1)击退实际入侵；(2)应对已向美国宣战的外国势力。OLC的解释是对社会、技术和地缘政治变化的适应，而非对建国先例的忠实应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新确立建国时期对防御性战争权力的狭义理解，挑战OLC的扩张性解释，为战争权力分权提供历史依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会和法院审查总统单方面军事行动提供历史标准，促进国家安全事务中的部门间合作，限制总统单方面战争权力。

title: Did the Defend Trade Secrets Act Spur the Reliance on Trade Secrets?
affiliations: Universite du Luxembourg

detail.title: Did the Defend Trade Secrets Act Spur the Reliance on Trade Secrets?

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-010
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores whether the U.S. Defend Trade Secrets Act (DTSA) increased the declaration of trade secrets. Leveraging cross-sectoral variation in the importance of trade secrets prior to the DTSA, empirical results show that the DTSA was followed by an increase in the intensive margin of trade secrets declaration in service industries, not in manufacturing industries though. The extensive margin of trade secret declaration increased in both services and manufacturing, where the surge was strongest in manufacturing. The extensive margin increased most strongly for manufacturing with a high sectoral R&D intensity. The results are of interest to policy makers as trade secrets can hinder knowledge flows with potential implications for innovation.

AI.tldr: 美国《保护商业秘密法》（DTSA）对商业秘密申报的影响：实证研究发现DTSA增加了服务业的商业秘密密集度申报，而制造业的广泛度申报增长最显著，尤其是在研发密集的制造业部门。
AI.research_question: 美国《保护商业秘密法》（DTSA）是否增加了商业秘密的申报？
AI.motivation: 商业秘密保护政策对知识流动和创新有重要影响，需要实证评估DTSA法案的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业秘密保护理论、知识产权经济学、创新扩散理论
AI.method: 利用DTSA实施前各行业商业秘密重要性的横截面差异进行实证分析，区分服务业和制造业，考察密集度边际和广泛度边际的变化。
AI.findings:
1. DTSA后服务业的商业秘密密集度申报增加，制造业无显著变化
2. 服务业和制造业的广泛度申报均增加，制造业增长最显著
3. 研发密集度高的制造业部门广泛度申报增长最强
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了商业秘密保护政策对不同行业的异质性影响，丰富了知识产权保护与创新关系的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据：商业秘密保护可能阻碍知识流动，影响创新，需要权衡保护强度与知识扩散的平衡。

title:
Do Treasury Bond Returns Affect the Stock Market Differently in Crisis and Non-crisis Conditions in Brazil? Evidence from a
Markov Switching Model
affiliations: , Federal University of Minas Gerais, Federal University of Minas Gerais and Federal Center for Technological Education of Minas Gerais

detail.title:
Do Treasury Bond Returns Affect the Stock Market Differently in Crisis and Non-crisis Conditions in Brazil? Evidence from a
Markov Switching Model
detail.abstract: The literature has documented a negative relationship between stock market performance and Treasury bond returns, or equivalently, interest rates. However, the magnitude of this relationship may differ between crisis and non-crisis conditions. This article aims to identify periods of crisis in the Brazilian stock market and to analyze how Treasury bond market returns affect stock market performance under both crisis and non-crisis conditions. The analysis covers the period from January 2002 to December 2024. Using a Markov switching model, we identify several crisis periods. In addition, we find an inverse relationship between Treasury bond market returns and stock market performance, with a stronger magnitude during crisis conditions. This article provides support for the formulation of effective investment strategies for capital protection during crises in Brazil, as such strategies reallocate capital toward Treasury bonds indexed to the Selic rate, which are commonly considered safe haven assets.

AI.tldr: 本文使用马尔可夫转换模型识别巴西股市危机期，发现国债收益率与股市表现呈负相关，且在危机期间相关性更强，为危机期间资本保护投资策略提供依据。
AI.research_question: 巴西股市危机期间与非危机期间，国债市场收益率对股市表现的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已记录股市表现与国债收益率（或利率）之间的负相关关系，但这种关系的强度在危机与非危机条件下可能存在差异，需要针对巴西市场进行具体分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于股市与债市之间的负相关关系理论，特别是危机期间安全资产转移理论（国债作为避险资产）。
AI.method: 使用马尔可夫转换模型识别巴西股市危机期（2002年1月至2024年12月），分析国债收益率对股市表现的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出多个危机期；2. 国债收益率与股市表现呈负相关；3. 危机期间这种负相关关系更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了危机期间股市与债市负相关关系增强的理论，为新兴市场危机期间资产配置理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西投资者在危机期间制定有效的资本保护投资策略提供依据，建议将资本重新配置到与Selic利率挂钩的国债等避险资产。

title: Coyote Lake and the Accommodation Doctrine in a Sea of Uncertainty
affiliations: Yale College

detail.title: Coyote Lake and the Accommodation Doctrine in a Sea of Uncertainty
detail.abstract: For more than half a century, the accommodation doctrine has quietly transformed from a narrow common-law safeguard against abuse into a significant check on the rights of the mineral owner. However, applying the accommodation doctrine consistently and appropriately is not a simple task. In this Note, I argue that the majority opinion in Coyote Lake v. City of Lubbock is partially responsible for this confusion, because not only does the majority appear to be at odds with the concurrence by Justice Boyd, the decision brushes by the property deed’s language, thus leaving it ambiguous how far the accommodation doctrine ought to reach. The result has been a methodological and legal confusion both about how the accommodation doctrine ought to apply and the breadth of its scope.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Coyote Lake v. City of Lubbock案中多数意见如何导致适用原则的混乱，认为该判决与Boyd法官的并存意见矛盾，且忽视财产契约语言，造成方法论和法律上的困惑。
AI.research_question: Coyote Lake v. City of Lubbock案中多数意见如何导致适用原则在方法论和法律适用上的混乱？
AI.motivation: 适用原则在过去半个多世纪已从防止滥用的普通法保障转变为对矿产所有者权利的重要限制，但如何一致且适当地适用该原则并非易事。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适用原则（accommodation doctrine）的演变理论、财产法中的权利平衡理论、司法判决对法律原则发展的影响理论。
AI.method: 法律案例分析、判例比较、文本分析（特别是对多数意见与并存意见的对比分析）、财产契约语言分析。
AI.findings: Coyote Lake案多数意见与Boyd法官的并存意见存在矛盾，且忽视了财产契约的具体语言，导致适用原则的适用范围和方法论变得模糊不清。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了司法判决如何通过忽视法律文本和制造内部矛盾来破坏法律原则的清晰性，为理解适用原则的演变提供了批判性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者提供了关于Coyote Lake案缺陷的分析，有助于未来更一致地适用适用原则，减少法律不确定性，并为财产权利平衡提供更清晰的指导。

title: Financing Freedom From Coercive Domestic Control
affiliations: Widener University - Delaware Law School

detail.title: Financing Freedom From Coercive Domestic Control

contentType.other: law review article forthcoming from Columbia Journal of Gender and Law, 2026

publicationDetails.journalName: Widener University Commonwealth Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Journal of Gender and Law

detail.abstract: This Article argues that the statutory elements required to state a claim under the Trafficking Victims Protection Reauthorization Act’s (“TVPRA”) forced labor statute equate to an enumeration of the definition of coercive-control-based domestic violence. Applied in conjunction with existing state court remedies, this framework can be used to maximize monetary damages for victims and supplement the collectability tools available, especially in high-net-worth New York matrimonial proceedings. Commentators have often limited their analysis to the intimacy of domestic violence, without exploring the financial constraints that prevent spouses from leaving, force the victims that do leave to absorb the compounding cost of exit and recovery, and fail to place victims in their rightful position had the harm not occurred. Essentially, this Article reframes the age-old question that plagues victims of domestic violence. Instead of asking why victims do not leave, it asks what leaving costs and identifies an additional mechanism by which that cost can be recovered.

AI.tldr: 本文主张《贩运受害者保护再授权法案》(TVPRA)强迫劳动法规的法定要件等同于基于强制控制的家庭暴力的定义。结合现有州法院救济措施，该框架可用于最大化受害者的金钱赔偿，特别是在纽约高净值离婚诉讼中。文章重新构建了困扰家庭暴力受害者的老问题：不问"为何不离开"，而问"离开的成本是什么"，并确定了回收这些成本的额外机制。
AI.research_question: 如何利用TVPRA强迫劳动法规的法定要件来最大化家庭暴力受害者的金钱赔偿，特别是在高净值离婚案件中？
AI.motivation: 现有分析通常局限于家庭暴力的亲密关系层面，而未深入探讨阻止配偶离开的经济约束、受害者离开后承担的复合成本，以及如何使受害者恢复到未受伤害时的应有地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强制控制的家庭暴力理论，TVPRA强迫劳动法规的法定要件，以及民事赔偿理论框架。
AI.method: 法律分析和理论框架构建，通过法律条文解释和案例分析，将TVPRA强迫劳动法规应用于家庭暴力赔偿场景。
AI.findings: TVPRA强迫劳动法规的法定要件等同于基于强制控制的家庭暴力的定义，该框架可结合州法院救济措施，最大化受害者的金钱赔偿，特别是在纽约高净值离婚诉讼中提供额外的赔偿机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将TVPRA强迫劳动法规重新解释为家庭暴力强制控制的法律定义；2) 提供了从"为何不离开"到"离开成本是什么"的理论框架转变；3) 建立了家庭暴力经济约束分析的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为家庭暴力受害者提供了额外的金钱赔偿机制；2) 增强了高净值离婚案件中赔偿的可执行性；3) 为律师提供了最大化受害者赔偿的法律工具；4) 特别适用于纽约州的高净值离婚诉讼。

title: Awareness and Utilization of Information Technology-Driven Agricultural Technologies among Rural Farmers in Cross River State, Nigeria
affiliations: University of Calabar - Department of Agricultural Economics and Extension, University of Calabar Calabar, University of Calabar and University of Calabar

detail.title: Awareness and Utilization of Information Technology-Driven Agricultural Technologies among Rural Farmers in Cross River State, Nigeria

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 19 (04), 41-54, 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: The integration of Information Technology (IT) into agriculture holds significant potential for transforming traditional farming practices, enhancing productivity, and improving farmers' livelihoods. This study assessed the awareness and utilization of IT-driven agricultural technologies among farmers in Nigeria. A multi-stage sampling technique was used to select 384 farmers across three agricultural zones. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire and analyzed using descriptive statistics, correlation analysis. The results revealed a high level of awareness of basic technologies like mobile phones (95%) and radio/TV programs (82%), but low awareness of more advanced tools like drones (15%) and precision agriculture tools (12%). Major sources of information were radio/TV (78%), peers (65%), and mobile phone networks (60%), while extension agents (35%) and NGOs (28%) played a lesser role. Utilization was primarily for market access (70%) and financial transactions (via mobile money) (65%), but minimal for farm decisionsupport and precision tools. Socioeconomic factors such as age, education, income, and ICT literacy significantly influenced both awareness and utilization (p<0.01). Key constraints included poor network connectivity (90%), high cost of technology (85%), unstable power supply (80%), and low digital literacy (75%). Farmers who utilized IT tools perceived significant benefits in market access, income, and decision-making. The study recommends strengthening extension services through IT integration, subsidizing smart technologies, improving rural digital infrastructure, and implementing targeted digital literacy training programs to enhance adoption and effective utilization.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了尼日利亚农民对信息技术驱动农业技术的认知和使用情况，发现农民对手机等基本技术认知度高，但对无人机等先进工具认知度低；使用主要集中在市场接入和金融交易；社会经济因素显著影响认知和使用；主要障碍包括网络连接差、技术成本高、电力不稳定和数字素养低。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚农民对信息技术驱动农业技术的认知和使用情况如何？哪些因素影响农民的认知和使用？存在哪些主要障碍？
AI.motivation: 信息技术在农业中的整合具有转变传统耕作方式、提高生产力和改善农民生计的巨大潜力，但需要了解农民对这些技术的实际认知和使用情况，以促进有效采用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、数字鸿沟理论、创新扩散理论，以及社会经济因素对技术采纳的影响框架。
AI.method: 采用多阶段抽样技术从三个农业区选择384名农民，使用结构化问卷收集数据，采用描述性统计和相关性分析进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 1. 对手机(95%)和广播/电视节目(82%)等基本技术认知度高，但对无人机(15%)和精准农业工具(12%)等先进工具认知度低；2. 主要信息来源是广播/电视(78%)、同行(65%)和手机网络(60%)，推广人员(35%)和非政府组织(28%)作用较小；3. 使用主要集中在市场接入(70%)和金融交易(65%)，农场决策支持和精准工具使用极少；4. 年龄、教育、收入和ICT素养等社会经济因素显著影响认知和使用；5. 主要障碍包括网络连接差(90%)、技术成本高(85%)、电力不稳定(80%)和数字素养低(75%)。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了技术采纳理论在农业信息技术领域的适用性；2. 揭示了数字鸿沟在农业技术采纳中的具体表现；3. 明确了社会经济因素对农业技术认知和使用的差异化影响机制；4. 为创新扩散理论在发展中国家农业环境中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供针对性干预措施：通过信息技术整合加强推广服务、补贴智能技术、改善农村数字基础设施、实施针对性数字素养培训；2. 帮助技术开发者了解农民实际需求和采纳障碍；3. 为农业推广机构提供改进服务的方向；4. 为农民组织提供技术采纳支持策略。
